title: Lycio turns up the importance of love with “I Feel Like Being in Love”
htmlContent:
Lycio turns up excitement with their new single, "I Feel Like Being in Love," the fourth track from their debut EP, Inbetween. The band is known for blending electronic and alternative music styles, and they take things to the next level with this song, creating a powerful and emotional experience.

"I Feel Like Being in Love" drives forward with strong beats, vibrant electronic sounds, and vocals that feel urgent and joyful. While Lycio usually combines deep emotions with powerful sounds, they fully embrace a heavier, more commanding style here. The song portrays love as a sweet feeling and as something intense and overwhelming. It captures the thrilling rush of emotions that comes with falling in love, almost like a heartbeat racing in anticipation.

https://open.spotify.com/track/4Crek5aKImkM3z4fInBztd?si=9ba7d377a3114c3b

As Lycio continues to make their mark in the alternative music scene, "I Feel Like Being in Love" strengthens their reputation for breaking new ground. It's bold, loud, and hard to resist. If this is their direction, we can expect more exciting music from them in the future.
